Lorelei: Lorelei: “Watch the thin place on your way out. I'll be here when it freezes again.”
Bruno: Bruno: “Shake out your hands. I had to do the same thing after the last turn.”
Agatha: Agatha: “Good. For a second I thought I'd have to put the kettle on while we were still fighting.”
Lance: Lance: “I have to check the roof after every bout. I don't mind doing it after yours.”
Will: Will: “Come closer. I'd like to see what a good surprise looks like from here.”
Karen: Karen: “You brought the team you wanted to be here with. I like that.”
Koga: Koga: “I will open the door and give you time to forget how I did it.”
Sidney: Sidney: “I had a clever thing ready for when you lost. Want to hear it anyway?”
Phoebe: Phoebe: “Wait with me until we can hear the people in the hall again.”
Glacia: Glacia: “I'll keep the door open a moment. I didn't realize how warm the corridor was.”
Drake: Drake: “What did you hear when your last partner came back? Hold onto that.”
Aaron: Aaron: “The little ones kept watching after the match. You had them interested, at least.”
Bertha: Bertha: “Take the last of the water, dear. There's always more on my side of the door.”
Flint: Flint: “I was going to make you wait to breathe. You made me forget to.”
Lucian: Lucian: “I thought I knew how that would read. I like the version we got.”
Shauntal: Shauntal: “Could you stay by the light a minute? There's a line I want to get right.”
Marshal: Marshal: “Good. You kept your feet while I was busy looking for a way around them.”
Grimsley: Grimsley: “Keep it. Every coin I lose on a fair match looks about the same.”
Caitlin: Caitlin: “I've stayed awake longer for worse reasons. Thank you for that.”
Malva: Malva: “Give me a second. I want to say it cleanly before they turn the sound back up.”
Siebold: Siebold: “The last thing on the tongue is the part you remember. Yours was very good.”
Wikstrom: Wikstrom: “I will hold the door. You have left me the courtesy of standing up again.”
Drasna: Drasna: “Come here, my dear. Let me see the team that gave mine so much to talk about.”
Hala: Hala: “You won't have to walk back alone. That's one of the good things about bringing a team.”
Olivia: Olivia: “Take the bright stairs. I can hear people on those.”
Acerola: Acerola: “Whoever was sitting there has gone. I think they wanted to see how you did.”
Kahili: Kahili: “Good follow-through. I remembered to look at your eyes the second time.”
Molayne: Molayne: “The numbers are still on the screen. I already know what they say.”
Hassel: Hassel: “I won't make you wait for a speech. I'd cry halfway through it anyway.”
Poppy: Poppy: “Did they hear that through the door? I hope they heard yours, too.”
Rika: Rika: “Done and witnessed. Now look at your partner before you look at the board.”
Larry: Larry: “I can take the loss. I still have time to get something to eat.”
